posts.author: Jordan Bastian
posts.text: Since Seiya Suzuki was put in the No. 2 spot on July 11, the Cubs' production out of the Nos. 1-2 spots included a 143 wRC+ and .887 OPS, entering Monday -- both first in the NL and 3rd overall in MLB in that span. Pete Crow-Armstrong and Suzuki opened tonight's game with back-to-back homers.
posts.jp: 7月11日にセイヤ・スズキが2番に配置されて以来、カブスの1～2番での生産性は143wRC+と.887 OPS。この期間、ナ・リーグで1位、MLB全体で3位。ピート・クロウ・アームストロングとスズキが今夜の試合を連続本塁打で開始。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Trey Mancini, the longtime Orioles player who made not one but two emotional comebacks to Major League Baseball, has retired, he confirmed in a text to The Banner. Mancini, who first told MASN of the decision, beat cancer, won a World Series and left a massive mark on the game
posts.jp: オリオールズの長年の選手で、メジャーリーグに2度の感動的な復帰を遂げたトレイ・マンシーニが引退した。マンシーニは癌に打ち勝ち、ワールドシリーズで優勝し、ゲームに大きな爪跡を残した。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Cubs walk it off against the White Sox for a second consecutive night, this time it's Alex Bregman's RBI single to CF that brings home the winning run in the bottom of the 9th for a 4-3 victory.
